string-array.name: permission_explain
string-array.item: The core features requiring specific permissions :
1) Intercepting outgoing calls.
2) Initiating calls via a long-tap action.
3) Notification permissions are required to utilize a foreground service.
4) Displays a confirmation dialog as an overlay on top of other apps.
5) Displaying a full-screen intent when the device is locked.
\nFor some models, granting additional permissions is required.

string-array.name: privacy_policy
string-array.item: 1. Information Collected
This app obtains the phone number when making a call.\n
2. Purpose of Use
The obtained information is used only for displaying on the screen and for redialing.\n
3. Third-party Provision and Transmission
The information obtained by this app is not saved. It is never sent or provided to external servers or third parties.\n
4. Disclaimer
This app is free software. No one takes responsibility for any effects caused by its use.\n
